note: The curated add-ons the in-game Add-ons page offers (server/addons.py; docs/ADDONS.md). Only these repos can be installed from it. Each add-on is downloaded from its author's own GitHub releases on the player's machine; nothing of theirs is copied here.

addons.name: Worldwide Trucking Career: Dangerous Contracts
addons.author: MadMerick01
addons.summary: A freight career on the real map: job boards in 178,000 real towns, a garage, trailers, fuel, punctures and dangerous high-paid roads.
addons.licence: Source available, not open source: free to download and play; re-uploading or sharing changed copies is not allowed.

addons.name: BeamNG.Earth Live GPS
addons.author: Leopri2008
addons.summary: Your Android phone's GPS follows your car, so Google Maps or Waze track your drive; plus a live map in any browser, a drive recorder and a fog-of-the-world map.
addons.licence: All rights reserved: free for personal use; no redistribution.
addons.note: A program that runs beside the game (it needs Python 3.8 or newer on this PC), not a game mod. Download it from its releases page and follow its README. Installing it from this page is planned once it can run without Python.
